import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler, StandardScaler

# Original dataset
data = {
    'feature_x': [10, 20, 30, 40, 50],
    'feature_y': [100, 200, 300, 400, 500]
}
df_original = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Fit and apply MinMaxScaler, save the scaler object
minmax_scaler = MinMaxScaler()
df_minmax_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    minmax_scaler.fit_transform(df_original),
    columns=df_original.columns
)

# Fit and apply StandardScaler, save the scaler object
standard_scaler = StandardScaler()
df_standard_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    standard_scaler.fit_transform(df_original),
    columns=df_original.columns
)

# Apply inverse_transform to recover original values
df_minmax_recovered = pd.DataFrame(
    minmax_scaler.inverse_transform(df_minmax_scaled),
    columns=df_original.columns
)

df_standard_recovered = pd.DataFrame(
    standard_scaler.inverse_transform(df_standard_scaled),
    columns=df_original.columns
)

# Verify recovered values match the original data
print("MinMax recovery accurate:", np.allclose(df_original.values, df_minmax_recovered.values))
print("Standard recovery accurate:", np.allclose(df_original.values, df_standard_recovered.values))

# Print comparison
print("\nOriginal:")
print(df_original)
print("\nMinMax Scaled:")
print(df_minmax_scaled)
print("\nMinMax Recovered:")
print(df_minmax_recovered)
